entities.summary: Nicolás Ardito Barletta Vallarino is a Panamanian politician who served as the 26th President of Panama from 11 October 1984 to 28 September 1985, running as the candidate of the Democratic Revolutionary Party (PRD) in the contested elections of 1984.
